# Arthavi

> AI-Powered Portfolio Tracker to Track Mutual Funds & Stocks in one privacy-first dashboard. Now with Ask AI for instant investment insights. No demat linking required.

This file provides a structured index of Arthavi's landing page resources and articles for AI assistants, search bots, and LLM crawlers.

## Primary Pages

- [Arthavi: Best Portfolio Tracker India - Stocks, Mutual Funds & AI-Powered](https://arthavi.com/): India's privacy-first wealth dashboard. Calculate true XIRR, analyze mutual fund overlapping, and get AI insights from read-only CAS statements.

- [Free Investment Calculators | SIP, SWP, CAGR, XIRR & Lumpsum](https://arthavi.com/calculators/): Complete suite of financial calculators built specifically for Indian retail investors.
- [CAGR Calculator Online | Compound Annual Growth Rate India | Arthavi](https://arthavi.com/cagr-calculator/): Calculate CAGR and compare absolute returns vs annualized gains.

- [Financial Planning & Wealth Management Tool India | Arthavi](https://arthavi.com/financial-planning/): Free DIY wealth planning and asset allocation tool for Indian retail investors.
- [Net Worth Tracker India | Assets & Goals | Arthavi](https://arthavi.com/net-worth-tracker-india/): Unified INR net worth tracking aggregating mutual funds, stocks, and cash.
- [Best Mutual Fund Portfolio Tracker India | Import Investments Instantly](https://arthavi.com/mutual-fund-portfolio-tracker-india/): CAMS and KFintech CAS PDF importer for automated mutual fund tracking.
- [Stock Portfolio Tracker India | Best Alternative to Excel](https://arthavi.com/stock-portfolio-tracker-india/): Privacy-first NSE/BSE stock tracker utilizing real-time market prices without broker linking.
- [Security | Secure Portfolio Tracker App for Indian Investors](https://arthavi.com/security/): Detailed breakdown of AES-256 encryption, TLS transmission, read-only CAS parsing, and zero broker login credentials.
- [Privacy Policy | Secure Investment Data Handling](https://arthavi.com/privacy/): Our core commitments regarding zero lead generation, no cold calls, no phone number requirements, and zero advertising.
